vulnerability_cn: 零数量转账触发交易池销毁与储备重写
vulnerability_en: Zero-value transfer triggers pair burn and reserve rewrite
detail_cn: BFB 的 transferFrom 允许 amount=0 继续进入 _transfer，之后无条件调用 _priceDeflPool。攻击者在小额卖出压低价格后，用零数量 EOA 转账反复从 BFB/WBNB 池销毁 BFB 并 sync，再用很少 BFB 换出 WBNB。交易回执显示池子净流出 350.616633079707222431 WBNB；源表保留 220,000 美元口径，技术报告按交易内价格约为 197,817 美元。Sourcify 显示 creation/runtime match，未本地编译或分叉重放。
detail_en: BFB transferFrom accepts amount=0, still enters _transfer, and unconditionally reaches _priceDeflPool. After small sells lowered the price, repeated zero-value EOA transfers burned BFB directly from the BFB/WBNB pair and called sync, allowing tiny BFB sells to withdraw WBNB. Receipt transfers show 350.616633079707222431 WBNB left the pair; the sheet USD scope remains 220,000 while the technical report values it near USD 197,817. Sourcify reports creation/runtime match; no local compilation or fork replay was run.
